items.title: XRP Ledger upgrade brings back features once pulled over critical bugs
items.summary: The xrpld 3.3.0 release is expected next week with five proposed amendments, including two revised features that were previously withdrawn after researchers found bugs that could have allowed unauthorized transactions or fee draining.

items.title: Solana Foundation's new CISO warns AI is making crypto scams more convincing
items.summary: Michael Coates, the foundation’s new CISO, said that AI vulnerabilities and fake identities will drive the next wave of blockchain security concerns.

items.title: Russia expands crypto mining ban to Moscow through 2032
items.summary: Russia has added Moscow, the Moscow Region and parts of Kursk Region to its cryptocurrency mining ban list, citing power supply concerns behind the restrictions.

items.title: Aave weighs closing 6 V3 blockchain markets, offboarding 50 low-use reserves
items.summary: DeFi risk management service LlamaRisk recommended that Aave wind down every reserve on Sonic, Scroll, zkSync, Metis, Soneium and Aptos, but action against most of those instances was already taken.

items.title: Coldcard issues Mk3 warning as experts examine $38M Bitcoin wallet drain
items.summary: Coinkite urged Coldcard Mk3 users to migrate funds after identifying a potential seed-generation risk, as Bitcoin security experts separately examine an unexplained $38 million wallet drain.

items.title: Coldcard hack sparks biggest sub-1 BTC move since FTX: CryptoQuant
items.summary: Bitcoin users moved 39,600 BTC in small transactions as the Coldcard hack continued, with researchers warning that the attack remained active.

items.title: Strategy holds STRC dividend at 12%
items.summary: Customarily, Michael Saylor and team have lifted the STRC dividend when it trades sizably below par, but not this month.

items.title: Bitcoin cold-wallet attack spreads to 4,500 addresses as losses near $89 million
items.summary: Galaxy Research flagged a third wave of sweeps tied to weak Coldcard-generated keys, with the attacker now targeting smaller balances and changing how funds are collected onchain.

items.title: Tokenized stock trading surged 288% in July, but one QQQ token drove most of it
items.summary: Without that QQQ token, QQQB, July volume for tokenized equities would be roughly $2.03 billion, about 30% below June’s total.

items.title: Bank of Italy research suggests stablecoins aren't necessarily cheaper for remittances
items.summary: A mystery-shopping experiment found that exchange fees, foreign exchange spreads and banking rails mean stablecoin remittances are often no cheaper than traditional transfer means.

items.title: Bitcoin mining difficulty shrinks 14% from this year's high as plunging revenues force operators to pivot
items.summary: Difficulty falls as weak mining economics reduce capacity, while forward markets signal little relief through year-end.

items.title: SEC to review Nasdaq bitcoin options approval after CME challenge
items.summary: CME argues that because bitcoin is a commodity, options tied to its value fall under CFTC jurisdiction, not the SEC's authority.

items.title: Everyone has the perps convergence backwards
items.summary: Crypto is said to be growing up to look like Wall Street. The evidence in its biggest market points the other way, argues Bitget CEO Gracy Chen.

items.title: Binance founder CZ calls for wallet diversification after $70 million Coldcard exploit
items.summary: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao says hardware wallets can still have bugs and suggests spreading funds across multiple wallets after the major Coldcard security failure.

items.title: How bitcoin cold wallets lost $70 million in an attack that never touched the devices
items.summary: Galaxy Research said weak seed generation let an attacker recreate likely private keys offline, sweep more than 1,000 BTC from nearly 1,200 wallets and continue searching without ever accessing the devices.

items.title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
items.summary: A case tied to defunct crypto exchange FTX moves forward, a soldier seeks to dismiss over a Polymarket bet and a former congressman was ordered to pay $35,000 for manipulative trading.

items.title: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
items.summary: State officials reported that Minnesota residents, and largely senior citizens, had lost about $1 million from scams tied to crypto kiosks from 2023 to 2025.

items.title: Crypto PAC pours another $1M into Michigan House race
items.summary: Michigan incumbent Shri Thanedar’s re-election bid against other Democratic candidates is getting more about crypto with an infusion of ads funded by an industry-aligned PAC.
